natureza: Referencia externa; extracao estatica da instalacao local. Nao e documentacao aprovada do projeto.

mapas.Title: Wooden Forest
mapas.Description: A thick forest with hidden dangers and treasures.

mapas.Title: Imperial Mausoleum
mapas.Description: Mausoleum of the Late Emperor, has been corrupted by dark forces.

mapas.Title: Buried Temple
mapas.Description: The Deity Dragon's Beard was once kept here until the great rebellion. The Beard was stolen by Prince Lu during the rebellion, and all priests in the temple were executed by the Emperor. The temple was later abandoned.

missoes.Title: {monsterslot} {monstertype} hunt request.
missoes.Description: My lord, {monsterslot} {monstertype} is posing threats to our town's safety. We better strike them down before they cause more troubles!

missoes.Title: Supply Shortage
missoes.Description: My lord, it seems that there have been an empire wide shortage of supplies! We may take advantage of this trend!

missoes.Title: Prologue
missoes.Description:
In order to survive in this chaotic empire, we need to be able to conduct explorations！
 Explorations will bring valuable resources for our town!

missoes.Title: Collector
missoes.Description: If we want to expand our town and attract more residents, it is crucial to have a strong economy. Resources collected during explorations can be used to produce equipment, which can be used to equip our adventure team or sold for profit!

missoes.Title: Path to Adventure
missoes.Description:
The Inn has always been a great place to meet up with different adventurers, and some may be interested in applying for permanent jobs in our small town!
 If you find yourself short of gold, we can always go to Adventurer Panel to sell unused equipment.

missoes.Title: Finance Management
missoes.Description: Products from all over the empire are sold in the shop. It can be quite helpful if we stock up on battle supplies!

missoes.Title: Town Management
missoes.Description:
Residents can make great contributions to our town.
 Let's add some new residents! My lord, you may attract more resident applications by completing adventures.

missoes.Title: Orc Threats
missoes.Description: Orcs from Wooden Forest are of great danger to our town! Since we have established a strong adventure team now, we may be able to defeat them once and for all!

missoes.Title: Blood Stone
missoes.Description: Slaying orcs may have drawn attentions from blood stone beast lives deep in the woods.

missoes.Title: Red Bird
missoes.Description: Our Crown Prince was kidnapped by a bird monster! Rumor says such monster was last spotted in Mist Forest!

missoes.Title: Evil Spirit
missoes.Description: Investigate Mist Forest.

missoes.Title: Furnace
missoes.Description: A permit for furnace? Interesting... Let's build one, my lord!

missoes.Title: Bone Demon
missoes.Description: Scouts of the Dragon Court have noted unusual movements around Buried Temple of the Deity Dragon. Since we cannot find much clues about Crown Prince in Snow Mountain, we may move on to Buried Temple for investigation.

missoes.Title: Blood Eyes
missoes.Description: Investigate Buried Temple.

missoes.Title: Demon Dragon 1
missoes.Description: Demon Dragon manifests powers from peoples’ worships of The Deity Dragon. It transforms the very sacred image of The Deity Dragon into sin and slavery, attempts to manipulate peoples’ mind for its own evil deeds. My lord, the whole empire is furious and we really need to revenge for our emperor!

missoes.Title: Demon Dragon 2
missoes.Description: Demon Dragon manifests powers from peoples’ worships of The Deity Dragon. It transforms the very sacred image of The Deity Dragon into sin and slavery, attempts to manipulate peoples’ mind for its own evil deeds. My lord, the whole empire is furious and we really need to revenge for our emperor!

missoes.Title: Snow Mountain
missoes.Description: There are so many worms in this Snow Mountain...

missoes.Title: God of Death
missoes.Description: Investigate Snow Mountain

missoes.Title: Tactics!
missoes.Description: Enable some powerful tactics for our adventurers!

missoes.Title: Hundred Battle
missoes.Description: Demons spread out of the Twisted Time are deadly and powerful! Slay them!

missoes.Title: Practice
missoes.Description: Let's try out these tactics!

missoes.Title: Challenge
missoes.Description: We have received a letter of challenge for our adventurers. Would you like to respond?

missoes.Title: Study, study!
missoes.Description: The sea of knowledge is endless, and diligence is our only boat for surviving...

missoes.Title: Shadows in the Wood
missoes.Description: Smells of corruptions come out of the Wooden Forest...

missoes.Title: Crystal Stone
missoes.Description: My lord, if you can send a team of adventurers to help recover my heirloom, I may be able to utilize it to improve our weapon quality.

missoes.Title: Gear Upgrade
missoes.Description: Furnace is a good way to recycle unused items. Combine items of the same type and quality, can produce a new item of higher quality.

missoes.Title: Mystic
missoes.Description: There is a mystic stone found in shadow pathway may be powerful enough to lift the seal. If we can acquire such stone, the full potential of our school may be realized!

missoes.Title: Dragon Blood
missoes.Description: My lord, in order to further upgrade our furnace, I think it is time to find Dragon Blood Stone from Snow Mountain.

missoes.Title: Demon Dragon 3
missoes.Description: Slay the Demon Dragon!

missoes.Title: Farming, farming, farming!
missoes.Description: Grinding can be such a delight!

missoes.Title: A Charming Flame
missoes.Description: This pile of ashes look so familiar….

missoes.Title: Hidden Cult
missoes.Description: Our Hidden Wood has been fully developed and is exposing dramatic powers. However, there are unsettling mists slowly leaking out of it… as if it is some kind of vessel.

missoes.Title: Immortal Corpse, Shijie Xian
missoes.Description: Black bead is releasing dark powers, as if it is summoning something!

missoes.Title: The heartless unicorn, Qilin
missoes.Description: Candlelight flickered, and mysterious scents developed. My lord, there are devilish lights radiating from Wooden Forest, shall we go and take a look?

missoes.Title: The soulless unicorn, Qilin
missoes.Description: Wind from the Mist Forest is biting my bone! And I could almost hear a woman singing…

missoes.Title: The sinless unicorn, Qilin
missoes.Description: These unsettling nightmares strikes me every night! They seem to hint a powerful source hiding in the Buried Temple…

missoes.Title: The undead aristocracy
missoes.Description: Explore Nether Palace.

missoes.Title: Exploration!
missoes.Description: My lord, since now we have earned trusts from the Dragon Court, it is time for us to setup our own exploration teams. With exploration teams available, we will be able to conduct multiple treasure hunts at the same time and serve the Dragon Court more efficiently!

missoes.Title: Evil Books
missoes.Description: My lord, the Dragon Court has requested us to kill royal librarian Zhuolun. It is believed that he edited Demon Dragon’s lies and made them available to public by spreading them all over the archived books!

missoes.Title: Remnants
missoes.Description: Your endless killing has summoned old evil spirits back into life form…

missoes.Title: Thugs
missoes.Description: Many rebels have gathered around at the Northern Territory and even invaded the State Office. It is only a matter of time for them to eventually spread into nearby states. Since they specifically targeted us, let us send our adventurers over to show our strengths. This may as well return a good favor for the Dragon Court.

missoes.Title: Nameless Rebels
missoes.Description: Investigate further into Northern Territory...

missoes.Title: Heresy: {dungeontype}
Heretic Demon Dragon：{dungeontype}
